lessonTitle: 61. Constructing a triangle from three elements
lessonTitleEnglish: Constructing a triangle from three elements
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Two sides and the included angle: build the angle, lay the given segments on its sides and join the ends.
stages.headlineEnglish: Two sides and the included angle: build the angle, lay the given segments on its sides and join the ends.

stages.headline: Three sides: lay off one side, then draw arcs from its ends with radii equal to the other two sides; their crossing is the third vertex.
stages.headlineEnglish: Three sides: lay off one side, then draw arcs from its ends with radii equal to the other two sides; their crossing is the third vertex.

stages.headline: Note: a triangle with three sides exists only if the largest is less than the sum of the other two; e.g. 2, 3, 6 is impossible.
stages.headlineEnglish: Note: a triangle with three sides exists only if the largest is less than the sum of the other two; e.g. 2, 3, 6 is impossible.
